facts.text: The Bridge to Clemson program offers an invitation-only academic transfer route for select first-year students.

sources.title: Bridge to Clemson Program
sources.quote: The Bridge to Clemson program is a selective academic transfer program offered by invitation only to talented first-year students.

facts.text: Students participating in the Bridge to Clemson program are guaranteed on-campus housing.

sources.title: Bridge to Clemson Student Housing Guide
sources.quote: Housing is guaranteed for Bridge to Clemson students.
